items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I auditioned for the producer and Danny DeVito, who was starring in it... Danny said, “Annie Ross.”

ctx.x: No, for Throw Mama from the Train, you were Mrs. Hazeltine, a creative writing student is what you’re listed as a character.

Yes, right. I went in. I auditioned for the producer and Danny DeVito, who was starring in it. They’re looking through my sheet, with my credits and stuff, and Danny said, “Annie Ross.” He said, “Yeah, there used to be a singer called Annie Ross.” I said, “Yeah?” He said, “Yeah. She was a good singer.” I said, “I’m Annie Ross.” Well, it turned out that his kids loved Our Gang. So, in showing it to the kids, he watched all the things. He said, “No, you can’t be, because she was in Our Gang in” 19-whatever-it-was.…
We had a – you talk about food. That’s the best food I’ve ever had on a movie set. Wow, was it good.
